items.mainDefect: The assertion runs without joining the reader thread, so an exception from its final request can be recorded after the test passes.

secondary.defect: No startup rendezvous guarantees the reader executes any reads before deletion finishes, allowing a vacuous pass.

items.mainDefect: The assertion races with the unjoined reader thread and can miss an exception from its final in-flight request.

secondary.defect: A late-scheduled reader can execute zero reads and let the test pass without exercising concurrent access.

items.mainDefect: The reader thread is not joined before the assertion, allowing its final request's exception to arrive after the test passes.

secondary.defect: There is no start barrier between launching the reader and deleting groups to ensure concurrent reads occur.
